Name: High Visibility Cinder Shard Node
Author: p0stpwned
Description:
I was having a lot of trouble differentiating Cinder Shard Nodes from Copper Nodes in the Ginger Island Volcano Dungeon, so I made this lightweight mod that simply makes the Cinder Shard Nodes a lot brighter and more colourful. I tried to make sure the colour still closely matched Cinder Shards themselves, while being easy to spot on the map.

Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].

Manifest.Name: High Visibility Cinder Shard Node
Manifest.Description: More clearly differentiate the Cinder Shard Node on Ginger Island from Copper Nodes
Manifest.Author: p0sTpWnEd
